name: Parsons School of Design
desc: Top-ranked design school of The New School, famous for fashion. Its Fifth Ave campus sits in lively Greenwich Village near Union Square; rents are high but transit is superb.
desc_zh: 新学院旗下的顶尖设计学院，以时装设计闻名。校区位于第五大道、紧邻联合广场的格林威治村，街区热闹，租金偏高但交通极为便利。

name: Pratt Institute
desc: Renowned for architecture, industrial and interior design. Its gated, tree-lined campus sits amid Clinton Hill's brownstones, with cafés and the G train nearby.
desc_zh: 以建筑、工业设计和室内设计著称。校园绿树成荫、自带围墙，周边是克林顿山的褐石公寓区，咖啡馆众多，步行可达G线地铁。

name: SVA
desc: School of Visual Arts, known for illustration, film and animation. Its buildings line East 23rd St near Gramercy Park, a walkable, central area with many studios and walk-ups.
desc_zh: 纽约视觉艺术学院，以插画、电影和动画专业见长。教学楼分布在东23街一带，靠近格拉梅西公园，地段居中、适合步行，周边多为小户型和无电梯公寓。
neighborhood_zh: 曼哈顿格拉梅西 / 基普斯湾

name: FIT
desc: SUNY's Fashion Institute of Technology, a launchpad for fashion and merchandising careers. The campus on W 27th St is steps from Penn Station, Chelsea galleries and the High Line.
desc_zh: 纽约州立大学时装技术学院，时尚与零售管理人才的摇篮。校区位于西27街，步行可到宾州车站、切尔西画廊区和高线公园。

name: Columbia University
desc: Ivy League university with the iconic Low Library and College Walk. Morningside Heights is a leafy, student-heavy area on the 1 train, with prewar apartments and Riverside Park nearby.
desc_zh: 常春藤名校，标志性的洛氏图书馆和College Walk广为人知。晨边高地绿树成荫、学生集中，乘1号线进出方便，多战前公寓，紧邻河滨公园。

name: NYU
desc: A global research university woven into the streets around Washington Square Park. The Village is vibrant and walkable with endless food options, though rents are among NYC's highest.
desc_zh: 全球知名的研究型大学，校舍融入华盛顿广场公园周边的街巷。格林威治村热闹宜步行、美食众多，但租金在纽约名列前茅。
address: 70 Washington Square South, New York, NY 10012

name: Fordham — Lincoln Center
desc: Fordham's Manhattan campus, home to its law, business and arts programs. Next to Lincoln Center and Central Park, the area is polished and safe, with easy access via Columbus Circle.
desc_zh: 福特汉姆大学的曼哈顿校区，设有法学院、商学院及文理项目。毗邻林肯中心和中央公园，环境精致安全，经哥伦布圆环出行便利。
neighborhood: Lincoln Square, Upper West Side, Manhattan
neighborhood_zh: 曼哈顿上西区林肯广场

name: Fordham — Rose Hill
desc: Fordham's historic Jesuit main campus with Gothic halls and broad lawns. Beside the Bronx Zoo and Arthur Avenue's Little Italy; rents are far lower than Manhattan, with Metro-North nearby.
desc_zh: 福特汉姆大学历史悠久的耶稣会主校区，哥特式建筑与大草坪相映。紧邻布朗克斯动物园和亚瑟大道小意大利，租金远低于曼哈顿，附近有Metro-North车站。
neighborhood_zh: 布朗克斯贝尔蒙特 / 福特汉姆

name: USC
desc: Private research university known for film, business and engineering, with red-brick Romanesque halls. Most students rent in University Park and near the Expo Line; DTLA is minutes away.
desc_zh: 以电影、商科和工程著称的私立研究型大学，红砖罗马式建筑是标志。学生多在大学公园区及Expo地铁线沿线租房，距洛杉矶市中心仅数分钟车程。

name: UCLA
desc: Top public university famous for Royce Hall and a sprawling, green campus. Westwood Village next door is walkable with student apartments, though rents are high for LA.
desc_zh: 顶尖公立大学，以罗伊斯厅和宽阔的绿色校园闻名。紧邻的韦斯特伍德村步行友好、学生公寓集中，但租金在洛杉矶属于较高水平。

name: Loyola Marymount University
desc: Jesuit university on a bluff overlooking Playa Vista and the Pacific. Westchester is a quiet, suburban area near LAX and the beach; most students drive or rent close to campus.
desc_zh: 坐落在可俯瞰Playa Vista与太平洋的山崖上的耶稣会大学。韦斯特切斯特安静、偏郊区，靠近洛杉矶机场和海滩，学生多开车或在校园附近租房。

name: Occidental College
desc: Small liberal arts college with a Mediterranean-style hillside campus. Eagle Rock is a relaxed neighborhood with indie cafés on Colorado Blvd and cheaper rents than the Westside.
desc_zh: 小型文理学院，校园依山而建，呈地中海风格。鹰岩街区氛围悠闲，Colorado大道上独立咖啡馆林立，租金低于洛杉矶西区。

name: UC Irvine (UCI)
desc: UC campus known for engineering, biology and computer science, built in rings around Aldrich Park. Irvine is safe, planned and car-oriented, with large student apartment complexes nearby.
desc_zh: 加州大学分校，以工程、生物和计算机见长，校园环绕奥尔德里奇公园呈环形布局。尔湾规划完善、治安良好，出行以开车为主，周边有大型学生公寓社区。

name: Cal State LA
desc: Public CSU campus known for engineering, criminal justice and affordability. It sits on a hill by the I-10 with its own Metrolink and busway stop; nearby Alhambra offers cheaper rents.
desc_zh: 加州州立大学洛杉矶分校，以工程、刑事司法专业和学费亲民著称。校园位于10号高速旁的山丘上，自带Metrolink和快速公交站，附近的阿罕布拉租金较低。
address: 5151 State University Drive, Los Angeles, CA 90032

name: Caltech
desc: World-class science and engineering institute with Spanish-style arcades and a small, intimate campus. Surrounding Pasadena is quiet and residential; Old Pasadena is a short drive.
desc_zh: 世界顶级理工学院，校园小巧精致，西班牙风格拱廊别具特色。周边帕萨迪纳住宅区安静宜居，开车不久即可到老城区。

name: ArtCenter College of Design
desc: Elite design school known for transportation and product design. The hillside campus is a Craig Ellwood bridge over a ravine; the South Campus is near the Metro A Line in Pasadena.
desc_zh: 以交通工具设计和产品设计闻名的顶尖设计学院。山坡校区是横跨峡谷的Craig Ellwood桥式建筑，南校区位于帕萨迪纳、靠近地铁A线。
neighborhood_zh: 帕萨迪纳琳达维斯塔 / 南校区

name: LA Film School
desc: Career-focused school for film, audio and animation on Sunset Blvd. Central Hollywood is busy and nightlife-heavy, with Metro B Line access and many apartment buildings.
desc_zh: 位于日落大道、以就业为导向的电影、音频与动画学校。好莱坞中心区热闹、夜生活丰富，可乘地铁B线，周边公寓楼众多。

name: Santa Monica College (SMC)
desc: California's top transfer college to UCLA and the UCs, popular with international students. Santa Monica is beachside, bikeable and safe, though rents are steep; many share apartments.
desc_zh: 加州转学至UCLA及各UC分校成绩最好的社区学院，深受国际生欢迎。圣莫尼卡临海、适合骑行且治安好，但租金较高，学生多合租。

name: Pasadena City College (PCC)
desc: Large community college with strong transfer rates and a reflecting-pool quad. It sits on Colorado Blvd near the Metro A Line; Pasadena is safe with moderate rents for LA.
desc_zh: 大型社区学院，转学率高，校园倒影池广场颇具特色。位于Colorado大道、靠近地铁A线；帕萨迪纳治安良好，租金在洛杉矶属中等。

name: West LA College (WLAC)
desc: Hilltop community college with modern buildings and views across the Westside. Nearby Culver City offers a lively downtown, tech jobs and the Metro E Line, with rents below Santa Monica.
desc_zh: 位于山顶的社区学院，现代建筑可眺望洛杉矶西区。邻近的卡尔弗城市中心热闹，科技公司聚集，可乘地铁E线，租金低于圣莫尼卡。
neighborhood_zh: 卡尔弗城 / 拉德拉高地

credits.author: Tracie Hall from Orange County, us
Tracie Hall from Orange County, us
Tracie Hall from Orange County, us

name: Otis College of Art and Design
desc: LA's oldest art school, known for fashion, toy and product design, housed in a former IBM tower. Westchester is quiet and close to LAX and the beach; a car helps for getting around.
desc_zh: 洛杉矶历史最悠久的艺术学院，以时装、玩具和产品设计见长，主楼由原IBM大楼改建。韦斯特切斯特安静，靠近机场和海滩，出行最好有车。

name: Georgetown University
desc: Jesuit university famed for international affairs and law, crowned by Gothic Healy Hall. Georgetown has historic row houses and riverfront shops but no Metro stop; shuttles fill the gap.
desc_zh: 以国际关系和法学闻名的耶稣会大学，哥特式的希利楼是其标志。乔治城遍布历史排屋和滨河商店，但没有地铁站，需靠校车接驳。

name: George Washington University (GWU)
desc: Urban campus blocks from the White House, strong in policy, international affairs and media. Foggy Bottom is central and walkable with its own Metro stop, though rents run high.
desc_zh: 距白宫仅几个街区的城市校园，公共政策、国际事务与传媒专业实力强。雾谷地段居中、步行便利，有专属地铁站，但租金偏高。

name: American University
desc: Known for international service, public affairs and its arboretum-like campus. Surrounding Spring Valley and Tenleytown are quiet and upscale; a free shuttle links to the Red Line.
desc_zh: 以国际服务和公共事务专业著称，校园如植物园般葱郁。周边春谷和坦利敦安静高档，免费校车连接地铁红线。

name: Howard University
desc: Leading historically Black university, with Founders Library anchoring The Yard. Nearby Shaw and U Street offer rowhouse rentals, nightlife and two Metro lines.
desc_zh: 顶尖的历史性黑人大学，创始人图书馆矗立于中心草坪The Yard。邻近的肖区和U街有大量排屋出租，夜生活丰富，并有两条地铁线。
neighborhood_zh: 华盛顿特区勒德罗伊特公园 / 肖区

name: Catholic University of America
desc: The U.S. Catholic bishops' national university, next to the vast Basilica of the National Shrine. Brookland is a calm, leafy area with an arts walk and its own Red Line station.
desc_zh: 美国天主教主教团创办的全国性大学，毗邻宏伟的国家圣母无染原罪始胎朝圣地大教堂。布鲁克兰安静多树，有艺术长廊和地铁红线站。
neighborhood_zh: 华盛顿特区东北布鲁克兰

name: Gallaudet University
desc: The world's leading university for deaf and hard-of-hearing students, with Victorian Gothic halls. It borders fast-growing NoMa and Union Market, with new apartments and the Red Line.
desc_zh: 全球领先的聋人及听障学生大学，校内多维多利亚哥特式建筑。紧邻快速发展的NoMa与联合市场，新公寓林立，可乘地铁红线。
neighborhood_zh: 华盛顿特区东北近郊 / NoMa

name: George Mason University
desc: Virginia's largest public university, known for economics, law and cybersecurity. The Fairfax campus is suburban and car-friendly; apartments are plentiful and buses reach the Orange Line.
desc_zh: 弗吉尼亚州规模最大的公立大学，经济学、法学和网络安全专业知名。费尔法克斯校区属郊区、开车方便，公寓选择多，有巴士连接地铁橙线。
neighborhood_zh: 弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯

name: University of Maryland
desc: Maryland's flagship, strong in computer science, engineering and business, with Georgian red-brick halls. College Park is a classic college town with new apartments and a Green Line stop.
desc_zh: 马里兰州旗舰公立大学，计算机、工程和商科实力强，校园以乔治亚式红砖建筑为主。大学公园市是典型大学城，新公寓多，有地铁绿线站。

name: University of Chicago
desc: Elite research university known for economics and its Gothic quadrangles. Hyde Park is a self-contained lakeside neighborhood with affordable vintage apartments and Metra trains downtown.
desc_zh: 以经济学和哥特式方院闻名的顶尖研究型大学。海德公园是自成一体的湖滨社区，老式公寓租金实惠，乘Metra可直达市中心。

name: Northwestern University
desc: Top private university on Lake Michigan, known for journalism, engineering and business. Evanston is a safe, walkable suburb with its own downtown and Purple Line and Metra to Chicago.
desc_zh: 坐落于密歇根湖畔的顶尖私立大学，新闻、工程和商科享有盛名。埃文斯顿是安全宜步行的近郊城市，有自己的市中心，可乘紫线地铁和Metra进芝加哥。

name: DePaul University
desc: The largest Catholic university in the U.S., with a leafy Lincoln Park campus. The area is lively and young, full of bars and brownstones, with the Fullerton L stop at the campus edge.
desc_zh: 全美规模最大的天主教大学，林肯公园校区绿意盎然。周边年轻热闹，酒吧与褐石楼林立，校园边就是Fullerton高架站。

name: University of Illinois Chicago (UIC)
desc: Chicago's largest university, strong in medicine, engineering and computer science. Next to Little Italy and Greektown, with Blue Line stops and quick access to the Loop.
desc_zh: 芝加哥规模最大的大学，医学、工程和计算机专业实力强。紧邻小意大利和希腊城，有蓝线地铁站，前往Loop十分便捷。

name: Loyola University Chicago
desc: Jesuit university with a lakefront campus crowned by the Madonna della Strada Chapel. Rogers Park is diverse and affordable with beaches and the Red Line at Loyola station.
desc_zh: 耶稣会大学，湖滨校区以Madonna della Strada礼拜堂为地标。罗杰斯公园多元且租金实惠，有沙滩，红线Loyola站就在校旁。

name: School of the Art Institute of Chicago (SAIC)
desc: One of the top art schools in the U.S., linked to the Art Institute museum. Its buildings span the Loop by Millennium Park; students live in downtown high-rises or ride the L in.
desc_zh: 全美顶尖艺术学院之一，与芝加哥艺术博物馆一体。校舍分布在千禧公园旁的Loop区，学生多住市中心高楼公寓或乘高架通勤。

name: Columbia College Chicago
desc: Arts and media college known for film, music and design, spread across South Loop buildings on Michigan Ave. The area has modern rentals, Grant Park and several L lines.
desc_zh: 以电影、音乐和设计见长的艺术传媒学院，教学楼分布在密歇根大道沿线的南卢普区。周边新式公寓多，紧邻格兰特公园，有多条高架线路。

name: Illinois Institute of Technology (IIT)
desc: Tech university famous for Mies van der Rohe's modernist campus, incl. Crown Hall. Bronzeville offers low rents, with Green and Red Line stops; many students also live in Chinatown.
desc_zh: 以密斯·凡·德·罗设计的现代主义校园（包括皇冠楼）闻名的理工大学。布朗兹维尔租金较低，有绿线和红线车站，不少学生也住在附近的唐人街。

name: University of Pennsylvania (UPenn)
desc: Ivy League university known for Wharton and its Locust Walk spine. University City is walkable and student-packed, with trolleys and the Market-Frankford Line to Center City.
desc_zh: 常春藤名校，以沃顿商学院和贯穿校园的Locust Walk著称。大学城步行便利、学生聚集，有电车和市场-法兰克福线直达市中心。

name: Drexel University
desc: Known for its co-op program and engineering, beside Penn in University City. Students rent row houses in Powelton Village and Mantua; 30th Street Station is next door.
desc_zh: 以带薪实习（co-op）项目和工程专业闻名，与宾大同处大学城。学生多在Powelton Village和Mantua租排屋，紧邻30街火车站。

name: Temple University
desc: Large public research university with the striking Charles Library. North Philly around campus has cheap rowhouse rentals; the Broad Street Line runs straight to Center City.
desc_zh: 大型公立研究型大学，查尔斯图书馆造型醒目。校园周边的北费城有大量平价排屋出租，宽街地铁线可直达市中心。

name: Thomas Jefferson University
desc: Health-sciences university home to Sidney Kimmel Medical College. Its Center City campus is near Washington Square and the Gayborhood, with historic rowhouses and great food.
desc_zh: 以健康科学见长的大学，设有西德尼·金梅尔医学院。市中心校区靠近华盛顿广场和Gayborhood，周边多历史排屋，餐饮丰富。
neighborhood_zh: 费城市中心华盛顿广场西

name: Saint Joseph's University
desc: Jesuit university on Hawk Hill, known for business and its Gothic Barbelin Tower. It straddles City Ave at the edge of the Main Line; quieter, suburban, with regional rail nearby.
desc_zh: 坐落于鹰山的耶稣会大学，以商科和哥特式Barbelin塔闻名。校园横跨City大道，位于Main Line边缘，环境安静偏郊区，附近有区域铁路。
neighborhood_zh: 费城奥弗布鲁克 / 温尼菲尔德

name: University of the Arts
desc: Former arts university on Broad Street's Avenue of the Arts; it closed in June 2024. The area remains Center City's theater district, walkable and close to many apartments.
desc_zh: 曾位于宽街艺术大道的艺术大学，已于2024年6月停办。该区域仍是费城市中心的剧院区，步行便利，周边公寓众多。
neighborhood: Avenue of the Arts, Center City
